bund17.name: 字林西报大楼
bund17.architecture_style: 竖向窗带与双侧屋顶石塔
bund17.height_note: Model envelope, including finials; use source notes for official vs photo-proportioned dimensions.
bund17.detail_note: 原1,148个结构石墙盒按7组同平面墙厚重建为共形并集，清除内部重叠侧面和T接缝，保留真窗洞及内退。逐窗核对25个中部大窗，其中24窗使用真实照片，最低中央窗因浮雕遮挡保留原材质；内部框条按照片细化，重复石条合并。双塔为厚实体、四根前柱、深暗开口、层叠方檐和低浅弧顶，前移山花；顶层后退窗改暗内景。约40m高度、未见侧后和细小雕饰仍有推定。
bund17.asset_license: MIT (original model); CC0-1.0 (photographic samples); retain ODbL-1.0 attribution for the OSM footprint

photo_texture.author: Suicasmo
photo_texture.scope: 24 individually mapped recessed glazing fronts among25 reviewed; lowest centre omitted because a carved stone plaque occludes the photograph. No photo is projected onto a whole facade plane.

wall_topology.method: Conforming union boundary of original same-plane .45m structural limestone boxes; actual openings and reveals retained.

bund12.name: 汇丰银行大楼
bund12.height_note: Model envelope, including finials; use source notes for official vs photo-proportioned dimensions.
bund12.detail_note: 右翼六扇窗保持30块原图玻璃采样和39件实体主框；修复结构墙内部重合面与T接缝，保留原窗洞、柱廊、穹顶、石缝和真实退距。细格栅及帘布仍有照片细节；未见侧后与尺寸含推定，不是摄影测量。
bund12.asset_license: Architectural reconstruction retains project attribution and © OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL-1.0 spatial provenance; Suicasmo CC0-1.0 photographic window samples

photo_texture.author: Suicasmo
photo_texture.scope: Six north-wing front windows, 30 individually calibrated glass panes; 39 solid primary frame components; fine grilles remain photographic.

bund18.name: 麦加利银行 · 外滩18号
bund18.height_note: Model envelope, including finials; use source notes for official vs photo-proportioned dimensions.
bund18.detail_note: 柱距、窗宽和主窗分格按2021照片比例校正；部分下部石墙及六块主窗使用原照片，保留真正窗洞和独立窗框。新增连续墙芯修复石块间贯通空缝，保留石缝边界；18mm灰缝退距、颜色及未见侧后仍含推定。不是摄影测量，贴图保留原照片光照。

photo_texture.author: ScareCriterion12
photo_texture.scope: Selected lower front stone faces and six independently mapped main glass rectangles

wall_core_repair.method: Two conforming continuous backing solids; no internal sides between occupied wall cells; original stone/window/photo surfaces unchanged.
wall_core_repair.visual_limit: Stone-joint boundaries remain; the repair removes unintended see-through gaps, not every thin grid line.
